text: Draft ScalaFIM protocol tools/calibration/protocol.json enumerates 36 backbone cells (2 designs x 3 fitted noise x 3 strategies x 2 true noise) and 14 planned excursions; rates require 36 null backbone cells. Historical d_crit=12 remains conditional Python-reference evidence pending native PM/mKH confirmation. Actual campaign now targets stationary run-initial AR, runwise intercept+3 DCT per run, both run-specific outputs, and separate null/effect streams. NumPy/R prototype simulator gate passed 21/21, but campaign-specific Scala gates and public fitter pilot remain unverified pending serialized sbt slot. No inference admission claimed.
